chunks: Everything in it that is from Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim ibn al-Fuḍayl al-Baṣrī, the companion of al-Riḍā عليه السلام, I have narrated from al-Ḥusayn ibn Ibrāhīm—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim ibn al-Fuḍayl al-Baṣrī.

key_terms.الْبَصْرِيِّ: attribution to Baṣra, identifying the narrator
key_terms.صَاحِبِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: a companion of Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِيهِ: from his father; a link in the sanad
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: I have transmitted it; a statement of direct narration by the compiler

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim ibn al-Fuḍayl al-Baṣrī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a sanad clarification in which the author states his transmission route to narrations reported from Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim ibn al-Fuḍayl al-Baṣrī, a companion of al-Riḍā عليه السلام. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission for hadith in the book and preserving the source lineage of the report.
